reply:
Dear Chinedu,

Thank you for your inquiry. We can supply 1,000 pcs of BL-35P, and the FOB Ningbo price is USD 6.20/pc. We are checking the sea freight and insurance cost to quote CIF Apapa Port, Lagos, and will confirm the CIF total once we have the shipment details.

Please note that we do not currently hold the SONCAP Product Certificate (PC) or SONCAP Certificate (SC) for this model, so we cannot confirm that the shipment can clear customs in Nigeria. As these certificates are required for the import and clearance process, please confirm whether you would arrange the required certification, or whether you would like us to check the process and costs with a qualified service provider before proceeding. The battery has a UN38.3 test report; this is not a substitute for SONCAP.

For payment, we accept either 30% T/T deposit and 70% against the B/L copy, or L/C at sight. The combination of a 30% deposit plus 70% by L/C at sight is not among our confirmed payment terms and would need internal approval.

The standard lead time is 35 days. BL-35P has a 350 ml capacity, USB-C charging and six stainless steel blades. We can also arrange an Alibaba video factory inspection or provide a sample at the ex-factory price, with international freight paid by you; the sample fee can be deducted from a mass production order.

Could you please confirm how you would like to handle the SONCAP certificates and whether one of our accepted payment options works for you? We can then follow up with the CIF quotation for 1,000 pcs.

Best regards,
Sales Team
internal_brief_zh: 买家要1000台BL-35P，报价意图为CIF拉各斯Apapa，但现有资料只有FOB宁波USD6.20/台，需核运费、保险及CIF总价。工厂没有该型号PC和SONCAP证书，不能承诺清关；需确认买家是否自行办理，或由业务核实第三方办理流程及费用。买家提出30%定金+70%即期信用证，现有可接受方案为30% T/T定金+70%凭提单副本，或即期信用证，组合付款需审批。交期35天。
